CAREERS

# Join the movement

We apply our passion for innovation to solve day-to-day software testing challenges. For us, leading solutions doesn't mean following the same old blueprint. We encourage our team to think differently, test their potential, and change the future.

[SEE OPENINGS](https://saucelabs.com/careers#career-jobs-section)

OUR VISION

## Our values put people first

01

### Transparency

We collaborate in a trusting, safe environment. We share knowledge openly as a team to increase our collective understanding and adapt our plans when needed.

02

### Respect individuality

We celebrate inclusion of different perspectives and experiences. Together, we grow and learn as we treat each other professionally while preserving our individuality (no strict dress codes here).

03

### Constant improvement

We're committed to continual improvement, even if that requires radical changes. We're not afraid to try new things and support our employees in their professional and personal growth.

04

### Ownership mentality

We're truly invested in our vision and our impact. We consistently act with our customers' and company's best interests in mind. We take pride in our jobs and work hard but take time to recharge.

05

### Ideas over hierarchy

When confronted with challenging decisions, we brainstorm a wide range of possible solutions. We test everyone's proposals objectively, without regard to one's title, so the best idea emerges.

PERKS & BENEFITS

## Benefits and perks

### Workplace benefits

We have a number of interchangeable workplace benefits to defray costs associated with working where you're most comfortable, whether at home or in one of our global offices.

### Equity

We're all owners at Sauce Labs. It's why ownership mentality is a core value! Full-time employees receive equity in the form of stock options.

### Health and wellness

It's important to take time to re-center and recharge. We offer virtual yoga and meditation classes, and reimburse wellness-related expenses.

### Parental leave benefits

In addition to observing local leave of absence benefits, we provide new parents with additional time off and a salary top-up so you can be present to support the needs of your growing family.

### Workplace time-off policy

Our U.S. Saucers enjoy flexible time off, while full time international employees accrue a generous amount of vacation time to use each year.

### For our Canadian Saucers

We provide full employer paid extended medical and dental coverage for you and your dependents with no grace period - you and yours are covered from day 1! We also have a generous RRSP matching program.

### For our U.S. Saucers

Health coverage includes medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents starting on Day 1! Saucers also have 100% employer paid disability and life insurance. In addition, Sauce contributes a 25% match of your 401(k) deferral.

### For EMEA & APAC Saucers

Language learning offering: For our EMEA team members we offer 4 language classes per month through an easy and flexible online platform.
